repos.name: rtk-ai/rtk
repos.description: CLI proxy that reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands. Single Rust binary, zero dependencies
repos.one_liner: A high-performance CLI proxy designed to drastically reduce LLM token consumption for developer workflows.
bullets: Built in Rust as a single binary with zero dependencies for maximum portability.
Acts as a transparent proxy to intercept and optimize LLM API calls.
Reduces token usage by 60-90% for common development tasks.
Ideal for infrastructure teams looking to optimize LLM operational costs.

repos.name: JerBouma/FinanceDatabase
repos.description: This is a database of 300.000+ symbols containing Equities, ETFs, Funds, Indices, Currencies, Cryptocurrencies and Money Markets.
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive, open-source database containing over 300,000 financial symbols across global markets.
bullets: Covers a wide spectrum of assets including Equities, ETFs, Funds, Indices, Currencies, and Cryptocurrencies.
Provides structured, standardized data for quantitative analysis and algorithmic trading backtesting.
Python-based interface allows for easy integration into data science and fintech pipelines.
Serves as a foundational infrastructure component for building financial research tools.

repos.name: tigerless-labs/autoharness
repos.description: A self-learning skill layer for Claude Code — distills skills from your real sessions, updates them as you work, and prunes the ones that stop getting used. No daemon, no benchmark.
repos.one_liner: A self-learning skill layer for Claude Code that distills and evolves agentic capabilities based on real-world sessions.
bullets: Implements a dynamic skill-pruning mechanism to maintain agent efficiency.
Operates without external daemons or complex benchmarking, focusing on session-based learning.
Enhances agentic autonomy by adapting to the specific coding patterns of the user.
Represents the next generation of infrastructure for persistent, self-improving AI agents.

repos.name: Farama-Foundation/MAgent2
repos.description: An engine for high performance multi-agent environments with very large numbers of agents, along with a set of reference environments
repos.one_liner: A high-performance C++ engine designed for simulating environments with massive numbers of agents.
bullets: Optimized for large-scale multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) research.
Provides a C++ core with Python bindings to balance performance and usability.
Includes reference environments for testing complex agentic communication and coordination.
Critical infrastructure for researchers building large-scale agentic systems.

repos.name: EvoMap/AutoResearch
repos.description: AI/ML research agents from idea to paper-ready evidence. An EvoMap open-source project.
repos.one_liner: An agentic framework designed to automate the AI/ML research lifecycle from initial ideation to paper-ready evidence.
bullets: Orchestrates multi-step research workflows including literature review, experimentation, and drafting.
Focuses on generating verifiable evidence to support research claims.
Leverages AI agents to bridge the gap between conceptual research and technical implementation.
Useful for quant researchers and AI engineers looking to accelerate the R&D process.
